verdicts.V1: V1  THE TRANSLATION TABLE: complete and consistent.  (a) M_dark = M_b r/r_M is the dark-mass distribution's expectation: mass elements uniform in radius on (0, r_M), E[M_dark(<r)] = M_b P(R < r) = M_b r/r_M (G154/G227 Lean-certified Gauss map).  (b) the 12-decade line is the joint P(log10 M_b, log10 v_flat) with conditional mean E[v^4|M_b] = G M_b a0 and conditional scatter rms 0.180 dex, whose residual distribution is measured below.  (c) sigma^2 = v_flat^2/2 is the phase-space velocity distribution's second moment E[v^2] = sigma^2 = C/2 (G084 rung-4), the thermal variable z* = m sigma^2/(k_B T0) - 1.  (d) r_M is the regime-switch point: g_N(r_M) = a0 and u(r_M) = 1/2 = the MODE of the log-acceleration distribution.  Every claim is a statement about the distribution; none of them lost information in the translation.
verdicts.V2: V2  THE CONDITIONAL-STATISTIC IDENTIFICATION: the deep line g_obs^2 = a0 g_N is the CONDITIONAL MEAN of log10 g_obs at fixed g_N (the law's expectation). It is the conditional median AND the mode IFF the residual distribution is symmetric.  Measured: the 542-object residuals have skewness -0.58 (a 7-channel-mixture artifact, the one-sided UFD shell) but a mean-median gap of only -0.004 dex -- the residual LOCATION is symmetric about the line -- so the deep line is simultaneously the conditional mean, the median (to 0.004 dex) and, for the symmetric central mass, the mode.
verdicts.V3: V3  THE HONEST STATEMENT: the distribution reformulation is MORE than a new language IF the scatter shape is predicted AND measured to match; it is a re-description if not.  Measured: (i) the 542-object residuals -- laplace by AIC (normal chi2 p 0.000, Laplace chi2 p 0.017, log-Lomax chi2 p 0.000); (ii) the per-ring RAR residuals -- laplace by AIC (normal chi2 p 0.000, Laplace chi2 p 0.000, log-Lomax chi2 p 0.000); (iii) the |residual| amplitudes -- lomaxFree by AIC (a Lomax-family member whose free shape runs to the EXPONENTIAL limit c -> oo on all three sets -- never the committed shape 2), and the committed Lomax shape-2 chi2 p 0.000.  The Lomax reading PRESCRIBES the RAR curve (the CDF = the mean) exactly, but the SCATTER at fixed g_N is measurement/systematics-dominated (within-galaxy white noise 0.0447 dex vs the O(1)-dex distribution width), so the width is not a Lomax prediction and the shape test is the fair one; on the shape axis the residuals prefer laplace, and the Lomax-shape chi2 p = 0.000 (REJECTS the committed-shape prediction).  Verdict: the reformulation re-describes the law faithfully, and its only NEW prediction (the scatter's shape) is REJECTED by the committed residuals.
